semiconductor_relevance: High — A&AT provides specialized materials and solutions essential for semiconductor assembly and component needs.
summary: A&AT specializes in manufacturing Magnetic Fluid Seals and offers a range of materials including adhesives, epoxies, die attach compounds, and underfill materials. With over 20 years of experience, they provide technological consultation and repair services, positioning themselves as a total solution provider in the semiconductor, LCD, and OLED markets.
capabilities: Magnetic Fluid Seals tailored to customer specifications
Adhesives and epoxies for semiconductor assembly
Die attach compounds and underfill materials
Conductive and non-conductive gaskets, seals, and O-rings
